# NETWORK ANALYSIS

# 1. Color Sets
```{r}
color_SampleType <- hue_pal()(17)

# using " unique(S_metadata$FruitType)" 
color_FruitType <- c("BL" = "purple4", "CH" = "red4","na" = "grey",  "ST" = "red2")

color_FruitSite <- c("THU" = "coral2","FIN"="skyblue","LOM"="skyblue4","IST"="blue2","MIL"="deepskyblue","VAR"="dodgerblue")

# using cold colors for batch 1 sites, warm for batch 2
color_FruitSite1 <- c("na" ="grey", "FIN" = "skyblue", "IST" = "blue2" ,  "LOM" = "skyblue4", "MIL" = "deepskyblue", "VAR" = "dodgerblue", "THU" = "coral2")

color_FruitVariety <- c("CDP" = "indianred", "HED" ="indianred1", "SUM" = "indianred4", "STA"="#CD2626", "SWE" = "firebrick1", "CIF" = "gold", "CIR" = "gold2", "DRE" = "lightgoldenrod1", "INF" = "yellow2", "MDB" = "yellow", "UNK" = "skyblue", "LOC"= "deepskyblue")

color_LifeStage <- c("na" ="grey",  "Mothers_2days" = "darkolivegreen4", "Larva"= "darkolivegreen2", "Pupa" = "darkorange2", "PupalCase"="#8B4500", "Daughter" ="goldenrod2")

color_Pop <- c("na" = "grey", "CEC"="#C1FFC1", "FRA" = "seagreen3" )

color_Expe <- c("na" ="grey","Fruits_0days" = "red3", "Mothers_0days"="darkolivegreen", "Mothers_2days" = "darkolivegreen3", "Fruits_5_6days" = "red4", "Larvae"= "green3", "Pupae" = "darkorange2", "PupalCases"="#8B4500", "Daughters" ="goldenrod2")

```

# 2. Prepare data 

## Dataset 1 (indiv. + host fruits)

### 16S
```{r}

ps_rare_16S_D1 <- readRDS(file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "2_RarefyData","Dataset_1", "16S_ps_rare_D1.rds"))

# Filter data (exclude Nat_Uninf_Fruits_5_6days)
ps_16S_rare_expe_D1 <- Subset_physeq(ps_rare_16S_D1, SampleType %in%  c("G0_Adults_0days", "G0_Adults_Fruits_2days", "G1_Larvae_Fruits", "G1_Pupae_Fruits", "G1_Adults_Fruits","G1_PupalCase_Fruits", "Artific_Inf_Fruits_5_6days", "Fruits_0days"))

# Rename + reorder Sample Type
sample_data(ps_16S_rare_expe_D1)$SampleType <- factor(sample_data(ps_16S_rare_expe_D1)$SampleType)

sample_data(ps_16S_rare_expe_D1)$SampleType <- sample_data(ps_16S_rare_expe_D1)$SampleType %>%
  forcats::fct_recode(
    Mothers_0days = "G0_Adults_0days",
    Mothers_2days = "G0_Adults_Fruits_2days",
    Larvae = "G1_Larvae_Fruits",
    Fruits_5_6days = "Artific_Inf_Fruits_5_6days",
    Pupae = "G1_Pupae_Fruits",
    PupalCases = "G1_PupalCase_Fruits",
    Daughters = "G1_Adults_Fruits")

desired_order <- c("Fruits_0days", "Mothers_0days", "Mothers_2days", "Larvae", "Fruits_5_6days", "Pupae", "PupalCases", "Daughters")  
sample_data(ps_16S_rare_expe_D1)$SampleType <- factor(sample_data(ps_16S_rare_expe_D1)$SampleType, levels = desired_order)


# counts -> presence/absence (binary table)
ps_rare_16S_D1_bin = phyloseq::transform_sample_counts(ps_16S_rare_expe_D1, function(x) 1*(x>0)) 

## Extract metadata
mtd_D1_16S <- data.frame(phyloseq::sample_data(ps_rare_16S_D1_bin))
mtd_D1_16S <- mtd_D1_16S %>%
  dplyr::rename(Sample = ID_pool)

## Extract taxonomy table
df_taxo_D1_16S = as.data.frame(tax_table(ps_rare_16S_D1_bin))
df_taxo_D1_16S$tax_ID = rownames(df_taxo_D1_16S)

## Extract table with presence/absence
df_reads_D1_16S = as.data.frame(otu_table(ps_rare_16S_D1_bin)) 
df_reads_D1_16S <- t(df_reads_D1_16S)
df_reads_D1_16S = as.data.frame(df_reads_D1_16S)
df_reads_D1_16S$tax_ID = rownames(df_reads_D1_16S)
## Merge table with presence/absence and taxonomy
df_wide_D1_16S <- dplyr::left_join(df_taxo_D1_16S, df_reads_D1_16S, by = "tax_ID") #merge the two (suppr "Species" column)
df_wide_D1_16S$Species <- NULL

## Remove taxonomy other than Genus
BF_D1_16S <- df_wide_D1_16S[, c(6,8:dim(df_wide_D1_16S)[2])] #subset + genus as row names + sample names as column names + transposematrix
BF_D1_16S$Genus <- make.unique(BF_D1_16S$Genus, sep = "_")
rownames(BF_D1_16S) <- BF_D1_16S$Genus 
BF_D1_16S$Genus <- NULL
colnames(BF_D1_16S) <- mtd_D1_16S$Sample[match(colnames(BF_D1_16S), mtd_D1_16S$Sample)]
## Transpose matrix
FB_D1_16S <- t(BF_D1_16S)
```



### ITS
``` {r}
ps_rare_ITS_D1 <- readRDS(file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "2_RarefyData","Dataset_1", "ITS_ps_rare_D1.rds"))

ps_ITS_rare_expe_D1 <- Subset_physeq(ps_rare_ITS_D1, SampleType %in%  c("G0_Adults_0days", "G0_Adults_Fruits_2days", "G1_Larvae_Fruits", "G1_Pupae_Fruits", "G1_Adults_Fruits","G1_PupalCase_Fruits", "Artific_Inf_Fruits_5_6days", "Fruits_0days"))

# ITS : rename + reorder Sample Type
sample_data(ps_ITS_rare_expe_D1)$SampleType <- factor(sample_data(ps_ITS_rare_expe_D1)$SampleType)

sample_data(ps_ITS_rare_expe_D1)$SampleType <- sample_data(ps_ITS_rare_expe_D1)$SampleType %>%
  forcats::fct_recode(
    Mothers_0days = "G0_Adults_0days",
    Mothers_2days = "G0_Adults_Fruits_2days",
    Larvae = "G1_Larvae_Fruits",
    Fruits_5_6days = "Artific_Inf_Fruits_5_6days",
    Pupae = "G1_Pupae_Fruits",
    PupalCases = "G1_PupalCase_Fruits",
    Daughters = "G1_Adults_Fruits")

sample_data(ps_ITS_rare_expe_D1)$SampleType <- factor(sample_data(ps_ITS_rare_expe_D1)$SampleType, levels = desired_order)


# counts -> presence/absence (binary table)
ps_rare_ITS_D1_bin <- phyloseq::transform_sample_counts(ps_ITS_rare_expe_D1, function(x) 1*(x>0)) 

## Extract metadata
mtd_D1_ITS <- data.frame(phyloseq::sample_data(ps_rare_ITS_D1_bin))
mtd_D1_ITS <- mtd_D1_ITS %>%
  dplyr::rename(Sample = ID_pool)

## Extract taxonomy table
df_taxo_D1_ITS = as.data.frame(tax_table(ps_rare_ITS_D1_bin))
df_taxo_D1_ITS$tax_ID = rownames(df_taxo_D1_ITS)

## Extract table with presence/absence
df_reads_D1_ITS = as.data.frame(otu_table(ps_rare_ITS_D1_bin)) 
df_reads_D1_ITS <- t(df_reads_D1_ITS)
df_reads_D1_ITS = as.data.frame(df_reads_D1_ITS)
df_reads_D1_ITS$tax_ID = rownames(df_reads_D1_ITS)

## Merge table with presence/absence and taxonomy
df_wide_D1_ITS = dplyr::left_join(df_taxo_D1_ITS, df_reads_D1_ITS, by = "tax_ID") #merge the two (suppr "Species" column)
df_wide_D1_ITS$Species <- NULL

## Remove taxonomy other than Genus
BF_D1_ITS <- df_wide_D1_ITS[, c(6,8:dim(df_wide_D1_ITS)[2])] #subset + genus as row names + sample names as column names + transposematrix
BF_D1_ITS$Genus <- make.unique(BF_D1_ITS$Genus, sep = "_")
rownames(BF_D1_ITS) <- BF_D1_ITS$Genus 
BF_D1_ITS$Genus <- NULL
colnames(BF_D1_ITS) <- mtd_D1_ITS$Sample[match(colnames(BF_D1_ITS), mtd_D1_ITS$Sample)]
## Transpose matrix
FB_D1_ITS <- t(BF_D1_ITS)
```

#3. SBM clustering

## Dataset 1

### 16S 

```{r}

SBM_bernoulli_16S_D1 <-  as.matrix(FB_D1_16S) %>%
  sbm::estimateBipartiteSBM(model = 'bernoulli')

memb_spl_obs_16S_D1 <- SBM_bernoulli_16S_D1$memberships$row
memb_otu_obs_16S_D1 <- SBM_bernoulli_16S_D1$memberships$col

SBM_bernoulli_16S_D1$storedModels %>% dplyr::arrange(ICL)

SBM_16S_D1_FruitType <- Order_Matrix_Plot(SBMobject = SBM_bernoulli_16S_D1, BF_mat = BF_D1_16S, mtd = mtd_D1_16S, variable_name = "FruitType", modality_string = c("BL", "CH", "na", "ST"), color_string = c("purple4", "red4", "grey", "red2"))

title_plot <- "SBM_D1_16S_FruitType.png"
 cowplot::save_plot(file =here::here("plots", "5_SBM&co", "Dataset_1", title_plot), SBM_16S_D1_FruitType, base_height = 20/cm(1),  base_width = 40/cm(1), dpi = 1200)




SBM_16S_D1_FruitSite <- Order_Matrix_Plot(SBMobject = SBM_bernoulli_16S_D1, BF_mat = BF_D1_16S, mtd = mtd_D1_16S, variable_name = "FruitSite", modality_string = c("THU","FIN","LOM","IST","MIL","VAR"), color_string = c("skyblue","blue2","skyblue4","deepskyblue","coral2","dodgerblue"))

SBM_16S_D1_LifeStage <- Order_Matrix_Plot(SBMobject = SBM_bernoulli_16S_D1, BF_mat = BF_D1_16S, mtd = mtd_D1_16S, variable_name = "LifeStage", modality_string = c("Mothers_0days", "Mothers_2days", "Larvae", "Pupae", "Daughter"), color_string = c("goldenrod2" , "darkolivegreen2","darkolivegreen4","darkorange2","#8B4500")) 

```
